# Information about this notebook

Seurat can help find markers that define groups of cells via differential expression (DE), e.g. per cell type. By default, it identifies positive and negative markers of a single group of cells, compared to all other cells. [FindAllMarkers()](https://satijalab.org/seurat/reference/findallmarkers) automates this process for all groups, but you can also test specific groups of cells vs. each other, or against all cells. 

# Set up

```{r load-library, echo=TRUE}
attach(params)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(knitr)
  library(DT)
  library(glue)
  library(Seurat)
  library(future)
  library(yaml)
})

config_util <- "util/function-de-go-config.R"
if (!file.exists(config_util)) {
  config_util <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "de-go-analysis", "util", "function-de-go-config.R")
}
source(config_util)

if (is_dego_param_placeholder(root_dir)) {
  yaml_root <- read_dego_project_yaml(".")
  if (!is.null(yaml_root) && !is.null(yaml_root$root_dir)) {
    root_dir <- yaml_root$root_dir
  }
}

cell_type_label_go <- resolve_dego_string_param(
  cell_type_label_go,
  yaml_key = "cell_type_label_go_module",
  root_dir = root_dir,
  label = "cell_type_label_go"
)
assay <- resolve_dego_string_param(
  assay,
  yaml_key = "assay_annotation_module",
  root_dir = root_dir,
  label = "assay"
)
if (is_dego_param_placeholder(dego_condition_comparison_mode)) {
  yaml_proj <- read_dego_project_yaml(root_dir)
  if (!is.null(yaml_proj$dego_condition_comparison_mode)) {
    dego_condition_comparison_mode <- yaml_proj$dego_condition_comparison_mode
  }
}
min_cells_per_group <- resolve_dego_min_cells_param(min_cells_per_group, root_dir)

dego_mode <- tolower(as.character(dego_condition_comparison_mode))
dego_mode <- gsub("-", "_", dego_mode)
run_global_in_notebook <- identical(dego_mode, "global_interaction")
show_global_interaction <- dego_mode %in% c("global_interaction", "both")
show_within_celltype <- dego_mode %in% c("within_celltype", "both")

if (run_global_in_notebook) {
  fgv <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(future_globals_value))
  if (length(fgv) != 1L || !is.finite(fgv) || fgv <= 0) {
    fgv_gib <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(future_globals_value_dego_gib))
    if (length(fgv_gib) != 1L || !is.finite(fgv_gib) || fgv_gib <= 0) {
      fgv_gib <- 200
    }
    fgv <- fgv_gib * 1024^3
  }
  options(future.globals.maxSize = fgv, future.rng.onMisuse = "ignore")
  n_workers <- as.integer(parallelly::availableCores()) - 1L
  if (!is.finite(n_workers) || n_workers < 1L) {
    n_workers <- 1L
  }
  plan(multisession, workers = n_workers)
}
```

# Read seurat object

First, we will use the seurat object as generated from the pipeline in the `cell-types-annotation` module.

Comparison mode for this project: **`r dego_mode`** (`dego_condition_comparison_mode` in `project_parameters.Config.yaml`).

# Minimum cell count filter (`min_cells_per_group_dego_module`)

All differential expression, volcano, and GO steps in this module use the same threshold: **`r min_cells_per_group`** cells (`min_cells_per_group_dego_module` in `project_parameters.Config.yaml`).

| Step | Rule |
|------|------|
| **Overall** (`r cell_type_label_go`) | Identities with fewer than **`r min_cells_per_group`** cells are removed from marker tables and downstream plots. |
| **Global interaction** | Each `cell_type.condition` identity must have ≥ **`r min_cells_per_group`** cells. |
| **Within cell type** | Each cell type must have ≥ **`r min_cells_per_group`** cells in **both** condition arms (`ident.1` and `ident.2`). |

Excluded identities are saved under `./results/results_`r dego_mode`/01-de-analysis/` as `Res_*_Low_cell_*.tsv` (overall and global interaction) and `Res_*_Skipped_celltypes_*.tsv` (within cell type).

```{r read-object, echo=TRUE, eval=run_global_in_notebook}
seurat_obj <- readRDS(data_file)
assert_seurat_metadata_column(seurat_obj, cell_type_label_go, "cell type labels")
DefaultAssay(seurat_obj) <- assay
```

```{r read-precomputed-overall, echo=TRUE, eval=!run_global_in_notebook}
markers_file_overall <- file.path(results_dir, glue::glue("Res_{resolution_list}_Markers_all.tsv"))
all.markers <- read_dego_markers_filtered(markers_file_overall, min_cells_per_group)
```

```{r read-precomputed-overall-excluded, echo=TRUE, eval=!run_global_in_notebook, results='asis'}
excl_overall_pre <- read_low_cell_exclusion_table(results_dir, resolution_list, "overall")
if (!is.null(excl_overall_pre) && nrow(excl_overall_pre) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n### Cell types excluded (overall DE; below min cell count)\n\n")
  print(kable(excl_overall_pre))
}
```

# Differential Expression (DE) Per Cell Type

We save all the tables with Differential Expression (DE) per `r cell_type_label_go` at: <font size="3"><span style="color:blue">./results/results_`r dego_mode`/01-de-analysis/&lt;FILENAME&gt;.tsv.</span></font>\

## Overall

```{r find-markers-cell-type, echo=TRUE, eval=run_global_in_notebook}
Idents(seurat_obj) <- seurat_obj@meta.data[[cell_type_label_go]]
table(Idents(seurat_obj))
all.markers_raw <- FindAllMarkers(seurat_obj, assay = assay, logfc.threshold = 0.25, test.use = "wilcox", min.pct = 0.1, return.thresh = 0.01)
overall_res <- finalize_overall_celltype_markers(
  markers = all.markers_raw,
  idents_counts = table(Idents(seurat_obj)),
  min_cells_per_group = min_cells_per_group,
  results_dir = results_dir,
  resolution_list = resolution_list
)
all.markers <- overall_res$markers
```

```{r overall-low-cell-excluded, echo=TRUE, results='asis'}
excl_overall <- read_low_cell_exclusion_table(results_dir, resolution_list, "overall")
if (!is.null(excl_overall) && nrow(excl_overall) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n### Cell types excluded (overall DE; below min cell count)\n\n")
  print(kable(excl_overall))
} else {
  cat("\n\n*No overall cell types excluded at min cell threshold ", min_cells_per_group, ".*\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r find-markers-cell-type-interactive-table, echo=TRUE}
datatable(all.markers, 
          options = list(pageLength = 5, 
                         autoWidth = TRUE, 
                         server = TRUE), 
          filter = "top")
```

# Differential Expression (DE) Per Cell Type and Condition (global interaction)

Here, we define cell identities as the interaction between:
   (1) the cell type label (cell_type_label_go), and
   (2) the experimental condition (condition_value1).

This creates composite identities of the form `<cell_type>.<condition>`, e.g., Amacrine.knock-out, Amacrine.wt, Bipolar.knock-out, Bipolar.wt, etc.

FindAllMarkers() is then used to identify differentially expressed genes for each `<cell_type>.<condition>` group compared to *all other cells* in the dataset, not just the corresponding condition within the same cell type.

For example:
   - Amacrine.knock-out is compared against all remaining cells, including:
       • Amacrine.wt
       • Bipolar.knock-out
       • Bipolar.wt
       • all other cell types and conditions

This analysis therefore highlights genes that are specific to a given cell-type/condition combination relative to the global cellular background, rather than performing a direct condition-to-condition comparison within the same cell type.

Composite identities with fewer than **`r min_cells_per_group`** cells are excluded from comparison tables and downstream plots (see `Res_*_Low_cell_global_interaction_*.tsv`).

**NOTE**: For direct within–cell-type condition contrasts, set `dego_condition_comparison_mode: "within_celltype"` in `project_parameters.Config.yaml` (see section below).

## Per `r condition_value1`

```{r find-markers-cell-type-condition1, echo=TRUE, eval=run_global_in_notebook && show_global_interaction}
Idents(seurat_obj) <- interaction(
  seurat_obj@meta.data[[cell_type_label_go]],
  seurat_obj@meta.data[[condition_value1]],
  drop = TRUE)
table(Idents(seurat_obj)) # View cell identities, get summary table
all.markers_condition_value1 <- FindAllMarkers(seurat_obj, assay = assay, logfc.threshold = 0.25, test.use = "wilcox", min.pct = 0.1, return.thresh = 0.01)
global_res_v1 <- finalize_global_interaction_markers(
  markers = all.markers_condition_value1,
  idents_counts = table(Idents(seurat_obj)),
  min_cells_per_group = min_cells_per_group,
  results_dir = results_dir,
  resolution_list = resolution_list,
  output_suffix = "condition_value1"
)
all.markers_condition_value1 <- global_res_v1$markers
```

```{r read-global-condition1, echo=TRUE, eval=!run_global_in_notebook && show_global_interaction}
all.markers_condition_value1 <- read.delim(
  file.path(results_dir, glue::glue("Res_{resolution_list}_Markers_all_condition_value1.tsv")),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
all.markers_condition_value1 <- filter_markers_min_cells(all.markers_condition_value1, min_cells_per_group)
```

```{r global-low-cell-excluded-v1, echo=TRUE, eval=show_global_interaction, results='asis'}
excl_g1 <- read_low_cell_exclusion_table(results_dir, resolution_list, "global_interaction_condition_value1")
if (!is.null(excl_g1) && nrow(excl_g1) > 0) {
  cat("\n\n### Global interaction — excluded identities (`r condition_value1`)\n\n")
  print(kable(excl_g1))
}
```

```{r find-markers-cell-type-interactive-table-type-condition1, echo=TRUE, eval=show_global_interaction}
datatable(all.markers_condition_value1, 
          options = list(pageLength = 5, 
                         autoWidth = TRUE, 
                         server = TRUE), 
          filter = "top")
```

# Differential Expression (DE) within each cell type (condition contrast)

For each cell type, cells are subset to that type and [FindMarkers()](https://satijalab.org/seurat/reference/findmarkers) compares two condition levels (ident.1 vs ident.2). Cell types with fewer than **`r min_cells_per_group`** cells in either level are skipped (see `Res_*_Skipped_celltypes_*.tsv`). Computation runs in `run-de-computation.R` when mode is `within_celltype` or `both`.

```{r within-path-helpers, echo=TRUE, eval=show_within_celltype}
within_markers_path <- function(suffix) {
  file.path(results_dir, glue::glue("Res_{resolution_list}_Markers_within_celltype_{suffix}.tsv"))
}
skipped_path <- function(suffix) {
  file.path(results_dir, glue::glue("Res_{resolution_list}_Skipped_celltypes_{suffix}.tsv"))
}
within_contrast_path <- function(suffix) {
  dego_within_contrast_path(results_dir, resolution_list, suffix)
}
```

## Within cell type — per `r condition_value1`

```{r within-contrast-de-v1, echo=FALSE, eval=show_within_celltype, results='asis'}
all.markers_within_v1 <- read_dego_markers_filtered(within_markers_path("condition_value1"), min_cells_per_group)
contrast_de_v1 <- read_within_celltype_contrast(
  results_dir, resolution_list, "condition_value1", all.markers_within_v1
)
cat_within_celltype_contrast_report(contrast_de_v1, all.markers_within_v1, condition_value1)
```

# Min cell filter — run summary
